summary: ALL TESTS PASSED - Iteration 167 tested LUMI Prestige major upgrade: 1) Domain-based privacy, 2) Auto-created domain channels, 3) Message threads with reply panel, 4) Rich presence system (5 statuses), 5) Message retention (90-day default, admin configurable), 6) Channel member management panel, 7) Voice call initiation. Backend: 27/27 API tests passed. Frontend: All Prestige design elements and UI features verified.

issues: Medmatch Team channel shows generic circle icon instead of Shield icon for domain channels. The Shield icon should be visible to distinguish domain-protected channels from regular channels.

action_items: Consider adding Shield icon for domain channel type='domain' in sidebar (currently shows circle icon)
context_for_next_testing_agent: LUMI Prestige upgrade complete. All 7 new features working: (1) GET /api/lumi/domain/members returns same-domain users with presence, (2) POST /api/lumi/domain/auto-channel creates 'Medmatch Team' domain channel with all domain members, (3) User search filters by same domain, (4) POST /api/lumi/messages/{id}/thread creates thread_reply type messages, GET returns parent+replies, (5) PUT /api/lumi/presence updates status (available/busy/in_meeting/ooo/vacation), GET /api/lumi/presence/all returns all, (6) GET /api/lumi/settings/retention returns 90 days default, PUT updates, (7) GET /api/lumi/channels/{id}/members returns members with status, POST add/remove requires admin, (8) POST /api/lumi/voice/call initiates call with 'ringing' status. Prestige design uses charcoal #36454F sidebar, teal #008080 accents, white chat area. Thread panel has data-testid='thread-panel', Members panel data-testid='members-panel'. DM view shows voice call button.
